title: A halting prefix determines the full run
statement: Let $r$ map bit strings to optional values, and suppose that once $r$ returns a value on a string, it returns the same value on every extension of that string. For any bit string $w$, natural number $t$, and value $a$, if $r$ returns $a$ on the prefix of $w$ of length $t$, then $r$ returns $a$ on $w$.
hypotheses_covered: $r$ is prefix-stable: any returned value persists on every extension
